---
title: "Welcome"
date: 2026-07-30
categories: [meta, R]
---

This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org), using R (via `knitr`) to render code chunks directly into posts and pages. Replace this post with your own writing — analysis, notes on new papers, conference reports, or anything else.

Because posts are rendered through R, code and output stay in sync automatically. For example:

```{r}
summary(cars)
```

```{r}
plot(cars, main = "Speed vs. stopping distance")
```
